
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/springsource/p/19723543" title="发布于 2026-03-16 10:30">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">没开电脑! 只用手机和QQ聊天, 让openClaw帮我"手搓"个AI新闻网站</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-layout-id="0"><span>最近探索下openClaw, &nbsp;昨天做了个实验, 全程只用手机和AI聊天, 从0开始开发一个AI热点新闻网站, &nbsp;完全部署上线, 整个过程服务器都没登录.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="0"><span>包括上面的中间件、环境、nginx、域名绑定、爬虫都是AI自行搞定的;</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="0"><span>整体效果还不错, &nbsp;装好后, 网站地址如下: https://ribao.tech/</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="2"><span>整个过程还是有些惊喜, &nbsp;下面记录下整个完整实现过程:</span></p>
<hr>
<h1 data-layout-id="4"><span>openClaw的运维能力验证</span></h1>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/323385/202603/323385-20260316101924475-612923297.png" alt="image" width="250" height="550" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p data-layout-id="6"><span>尝试安装个mysql</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="7"><span>特意指定下版本 5.6</span></p>
<p><span data-type="text"><img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde57eeb2089f7c6e8ecca88cf001f6503e875b8339e1c4c24831b75b38faadcd24bec177c308ebd5304c6c6620a03fdcea3b0019cc922d05e0b8a6fbe1a2fed367d033be2620607a73c44740fc3fc03afdf4fb4c8ed7016461c?tmpCode=fac44b4f-aec2-4a67-8ebc-2cf0f4d9867b" width="237" height="521" name="image.png"></span></p>
<p><span data-type="text"><img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde57eeb2089f7c6e8ecca88cf001f6503e875b8339e1c4c24831b75b38faadcd24bec177c308ebd53045ee58f449957960bbd59c5d7f95de3648aaa98d45bcbda3f226f2c74703e59fc279a31b1482db1b84fb4c8ed7016461c?tmpCode=fac44b4f-aec2-4a67-8ebc-2cf0f4d9867b" width="230" height="506" name="image.png"></span></p>
<p data-layout-id="10"><span>没啥难度, 完成✅</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="11"><span>安装个tomcat</span></p>
<p><span data-type="text"><img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde57eeb2089f7c6e8ecca88cf001f6503e875b8339e1c4c24831b75b38faadcd24bec177c308ebd5304b384a80034a10414577021a3799a3d4b69f31ad7c283c12dd1c068608649370f445dd2be3a1fbcf34fb4c8ed7016461c?tmpCode=dcae116d-c173-4169-9ee9-66f8f48c1128" width="241" height="491" name="image.png"></span></p>
<p data-layout-id="13"><span>完成, 但发现访问不通, 检查原因是: 8080端口没开, 默认开的80端口</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="14"><span>那么让它前面架设个nginx反向代理</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="15"><span>安装个nginx</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/323385/202603/323385-20260316102227312-917361820.png" alt="image" width="243" height="511" loading="lazy"></p>
<p data-layout-id="17"><span>不错, 链路图都出来了</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="18"><span>访问成功</span></p>
<p><span data-type="text"><img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde57eeb2089f7c6e8ecca88cf001f6503e875b8339e1c4c24831b75b38faadcd24bec177c308ebd5304e20785f6c2ec62c80025cd10795916911ed19929f3bc352b446b4002cc164f8b1259e0cb4f4ce95b4fb4c8ed7016461c?tmpCode=ed632c94-21e1-4dc7-8762-fa6b23c80eaa" width="631" height="373" name="image.png"></span></p>
<br>
<p data-layout-id="20"><span>到此刻, 说明整个服务器的运维, 基本中间件的安装维护, 可以判断openClaw都能搞定.</span></p>
<hr>
<h1 data-layout-id="22"><span>上点难度: 实现个简单的登录注册</span></h1>
<p data-layout-id="23"><span>稍微上点难度, 来个登录注册</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="24"><span>试试程序员入门级, &nbsp;用java开发个登录注册</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="25"><span>提示词:</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="26"><span><span>“</span></span></p>
<p data-layout-id="27"><span><span>开发个登录注册功能, 前端基于Next.js, 基于java 21, spring boot框架, 数据库通过mysql, 先默认初始化个用户:admin 密码:1234567</span></span></p>
<p data-layout-id="28"><span><span>”</span></span></p>
<p data-layout-id="29"><span>可能是模型问题 (用的GLM 4.7) , &nbsp;还是没办法一步到位, 稍微调试了下, 也完成了.</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="30"><span>访问:http://43.128.242.170/</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span data-type="text"><img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde57eeb2089f7c6e8ecca88cf001f6503e875b8339e1c4c24831b75b38faadcd24bec177c308ebd53049bb9e094ff8681ba0197a14bc3c539c2fe34c9addb6839a1e648252bd5e4f7b5f9b2321f3aaa6ecc4fb4c8ed7016461c?tmpCode=6f75e585-8d56-45ed-b71b-ddf75274111a" width="720" height="412" name="image.png"></span></p>
<p data-layout-id="32"><span>试试注册功能</span></p>
<p><span data-type="text"><img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde57eeb2089f7c6e8ecca88cf001f6503e875b8339e1c4c24831b75b38faadcd24bec177c308ebd53040e59ff7bbe467db362d112c22e0043f47b686930d297170974bde2d5422038a38f0a3d9ba28daeb84fb4c8ed7016461c?tmpCode=4867de66-4a6f-42b9-a5b5-5be5656df7e0" width="716" height="755" name="image.png"></span></p>

<br>
<p data-layout-id="34"><span>登录成功, &nbsp;界面还是不错, 已经初步具备可以用的雏形了.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span data-type="text"><img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde57eeb2089f7c6e8ecca88cf001f6503e875b8339e1c4c24831b75b38faadcd24bec177c308ebd5304f7d87769c06984ffd9d63a999c7229b3473dbe756ca6164e88c2739f85295a68c0c112e05be0ffd44fb4c8ed7016461c?tmpCode=1626568f-2367-4941-9d90-36168d61e61e" width="713" height="488" name="image.png"></span></p>
<hr>
<h1 data-layout-id="37"><span><span>再升级: 做个AI热点新闻爬虫网&nbsp;</span></span></h1>

<span>打算做一个小功能, 采集海外的推特、 整个提示词如下:</span><span><span>“</span></span><ol class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span><span>把登录的url改成</span></span><span><span>admin/login&nbsp;</span></span></li>
<li><span><span>登录成功后调整改成url</span></span><span><span>&nbsp;admin/login/controlpanel</span></span></li>
<li><span><span>把首页改成显示最10条最热门AI相关的讨论主题, 从x、Reddit等. 实现方式</span></span></li>
<li><span><span>爬取AI应用相关新闻</span></span></li>
<li><span><span>调用智普AI, 通过APPKEY: 19a8cxxxxxxxxx.NDcxqXyxxxi8SLx 进行连接, 对讨论进行总结, 并翻译成中文, 插入到数据库</span></span></li>
<li><span><span>在首页进行展示</span></span></li>
<li><span><span>可以手工触发管理</span></span></li>

</ol><span><span>”</span></span><span>这个可能是我的提示词不够清晰, 模型也不是很好(用的GLM 4.7), &nbsp;来回调试了几轮. 最终还是出来了</span><span><span>采集展示了最新的AI趋势</span></span>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/323385/202603/323385-20260316102608115-1474590381.png" alt="image" width="640" height="630" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<h1 data-layout-id="51"><span><span>最后绑个域名</span></span></h1>

<span><span>这里通过腾讯云的小程序绑定下DNS解析</span></span>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/323385/202603/323385-20260316102647340-972268589.png" alt="image" width="341" height="496" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>然后服务端让小龙虾自行绑定</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/323385/202603/323385-20260316102720545-554891338.png" alt="image" width="303" height="333" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>OK, 完美</span><span><br></span></p>
<hr>
<p><span><br></span><span>当天TOKEN消耗也展示下</span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;list&quot;,{&quot;type&quot;:&quot;ul&quot;,&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-size: 15px;font-weight: 300;color: rgba(0,0,0,0.9);line-height: 2.0;margin-bottom: 24px;&quot;,&quot;class&quot;:&quot;list-paddingleft-1&quot;,&quot;start&quot;:null},&quot;listitem&quot;,{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;color: rgba(43, 119, 191, 1);text-align: left;margin-bottom: 0px;&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;data-layout-id&quot;:&quot;64&quot;,&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-size: 17px;font-weight: 300;color: rgba(0,0,0,0.9);margin-bottom: 24px;line-height: 2.0;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><br></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/323385/202603/323385-20260316102746461-1880085615.png" alt="image" width="546" height="235" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr><strong>最后</strong>
<p data-layout-id="59"><span>整个网站部署下来, 除了部署openclaw, &nbsp;我连电脑都没开, &nbsp;全程通过qq手机操作完成, &nbsp;也没ssh到服务器上, 全程通过openClaw操作.</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="60"><span><span>“这种最大价值在于, &nbsp;AI助理全程在线, &nbsp;随时能把你的想法快速实现”</span></span></p>
<p data-layout-id="61"><span><span>进一步:</span></span></p>
<p data-layout-id="61"><span>可以给它扩展更多的skill、MCP等, 本质上,感觉像在qq(或者其他 channel)远程运行Claude Code, 等于给大模型加上了手脚, 比和单纯聊天进化到了可以帮忙做事</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="63"><span><span>风险:</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>谨慎在自己机器上使用, 最好搞个服务器隔离</span></li>


</ul>
<p>
<span><br></span><span>持续探索AI对程序员的改变, 看看未来的软件开发会变成什么样子</span><span>如果你也对这个方向感兴趣, 欢迎关注, 一起探索</span></p>
